name: Injected private menu runtime composition
phase: Discovery and specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
scope: One pure injected composition factory assembling the existing menu D1 repository, single-admin service and framework-neutral workspace. No environment or server-context acquisition.
architecturalPurpose: Provide trusted integration callers with authorized menu operations and workspace presentation over one object graph, before separately scoped environment acquisition, server-context acquisition, menu authorization transport and activation gates.

conclusions: D1FoodMenuRepository(database, dependencies) structurally checks prepare/batch and exact getProduct/getRecipe without invoking them; binds read methods to their original dependency receiver.
SingleAdminFoodMenuService accepts repository, callerResolver and administratorPrincipalId, validates structurally and canonically, and performs fresh authorization only during operations.

createPrivateFoodMenuWorkspaceController(service) structurally checks all service methods and returns a frozen controller with 23 wrappers and getOfferWorkspaceDetail; no construction-time service calls.

No existing private menu runtime factory exists. FOOD-001E/K demonstrate private repository exposure and frozen capability containers, but their configuration-unavailable result and draft gate are not imposed on this menu boundary.

factory.name: createPrivateFoodMenuRuntimeComposition
factory.inputDefinition: export interface FoodPrivateMenuRuntimeCompositionInput { readonly database: FoodD1Database; readonly readDependencies: FoodMenuReadDependencies; readonly callerResolver: SessionPrincipalResolver; readonly administratorPrincipalId: PrincipalId; }
factory.outputDefinition: export interface FoodPrivateMenuRuntimeCapabilities { readonly service: FoodPrivateMenuService; readonly workspace: FoodPrivateMenuWorkspaceController; }
factory.output: Return exactly Object.freeze({ service, workspace }); no success/failure result envelope and no promise.
factory.exposure: Only authorized service and workspace. Keep repository, database, read dependencies, resolver, administrator, session, principal and tokens private. Repository exposure would bypass FOOD-002E authorization and is unnecessary.
factory.workspaceDecision: Include the existing FOOD-002F controller because this composition explicitly assembles persistence/service/workspace. Unlike FOOD-001K, there is no gate capability to expose or HTTP transport to assemble.

constructionFlow: Capture the four required input properties once in order: database, readDependencies, callerResolver, administratorPrincipalId. Require the outer input to be a non-null non-array object; do not inspect unrelated properties or normalize values.
Construct exactly one D1FoodMenuRepository(database, readDependencies). Pass the exact injected objects; preserve the repository's original receiver binding of getProduct/getRecipe.
Construct exactly one SingleAdminFoodMenuService({ repository, callerResolver, administratorPrincipalId }) using that repository and the exact injected resolver and principal value.
Construct exactly one workspace through createPrivateFoodMenuWorkspaceController(service) using that exact service instance.

Return a shallow-frozen two-field capability bundle. Do not deep-freeze or clone injected dependencies, repository or service instances; preserve existing workspace freezing and snapshot immutability.

Each successful invocation creates a fresh repository, service and workspace. Sharing injected database/read dependencies between invocations is permitted; no module/global object graph or authorization cache.
constructionPurity: Synchronous and I/O-free; structural property checks and constructors only. No prepare, batch, prepared-statement operations, getProduct/getRecipe, resolve, workspace/service/repository operations or clock calls.
No environment/global/runtime acquisition, import.meta.env, process.env, cloudflare:workers, Astro locals, request context or binding lookup.
Do not probe schema, migrations, sessions, principals, database existence or consistency. No configured database access or migration execution.

Assembly is deterministic in structure and wiring from injected dependencies; fresh instance identities are expected. Property getters may be read for structural checks, but throwing access fails construction without internal leakage.
authorizationPreservation: FOOD-002E remains sole menu authorization authority: canonical injected administrator, fresh resolver call before input validation/use and repository access on every operation.
Denied/unavailable callers perform zero repository, food database or FOOD-001 dependency operations. Possession of an identity is never permission.
No hardcoded/inferred/defaulted/trimmed administrator, duplicate authorization checks, authorization cache, reusable token, inherited permission or menu D2-style callback gate.
Workspace aggregate retains separate fresh service authorization for exact offer and exact-version availability calls; no atomic aggregate or authorization-once claim.
persistencePreservation: FOOD-002D/G remain repository/canonical serialization/concurrency authorities. Preserve all 23 promise-based operations and exact arguments, outcomes, pages, cursors and error semantics.

FoodMenuReadDependencies is Pick<FoodDraftRepository, 'getProduct' | 'getRecipe'>. Inject only these exact-read capabilities; composition performs no lookups and constructs no FOOD-001 repository/service/runtime.
No latest FOOD-001 reads, physical cross-database foreign-key assumption, co-location requirement, version generation, overwrite, renumbering, merging, automatic retry or evidence retargeting.

Injected D1 must meet FOOD-002G's primary-consistent access contract; construction cannot verify this. Exact historical references and independent exact-offer-version availability streams remain unchanged.

failureSemantics.outerInputFailure: Missing/null/array/non-object outer input or throwing access while capturing its four properties throws TypeError('Private food menu runtime composition input is unavailable.'). No values or original exceptions escape.
failureSemantics.repositoryConstructionFailure: Preserve TypeError('Food menu repository dependencies are unavailable.') from D1FoodMenuRepository for invalid database/read dependencies, including throwing property access.
failureSemantics.serviceConstructionFailure: Preserve TypeError('Private food menu service configuration is unavailable.') for malformed resolver or noncanonical administrator, including throwing property access.
failureSemantics.workspaceConstructionFailure: Preserve TypeError('Private food menu workspace configuration is unavailable.') if existing workspace structural checks fail; valid freshly constructed service should satisfy them.
failureSemantics.ordering: Capture input properties, then repository, service, workspace in that order. A later constructor failure may leave an unexposed allocated object, but never I/O or a partial returned bundle. Do not catch constructor failures into a new result vocabulary or default/fallback graph.
failureSemantics.operations: Preserve FOOD-002E's five service codes and FOOD-002F's fixed feedback unchanged. Construction TypeErrors are separate from later operation results; no domain/runtime result failure is introduced by H.

activationBoundary: Successful construction proves only structural assembly, not configured D1 existence, schema/migration application, binding acquisition, administrator acquisition, dependency trust, valid session or live authorization.
No assertion of primary consistency, public menu activation, live publication, availability freshness, ordering enablement, readiness or sale authority.

A stored published snapshot remains only that snapshot state. Later environment/server acquisition, configuration/provisioning/migrations and route/public activation require separate explicit scope and approval gates.
compatibility: Do not change FOOD-002D/E/F/G contracts, constructors, factories, tests or source; H is two new implementation/test files only when separately authorized.

Keep createPrivateFoodMenuWorkspaceController and existing narrow direct constructors available unchanged. There is no existing menu narrow runtime factory to replace or broaden, so do not invent a redundant companion factory.
All FOOD-001 narrow/capability factories remain unchanged. H does not expose or construct a gate, nor copy FOOD-001E's configuration result contract.
testObligations: Valid synchronous construction returns exactly service/workspace, a shallow-frozen read-only bundle; workspace retains its existing frozen surface. No repository/database/read-dependency/resolver/admin/session/principal/token exposure.
Counters/poison methods prove zero database prepare/batch/statement, FOOD-001 getProduct/getRecipe, resolver, service and workspace calls during construction; no configured D1 is used.

Instrument imported constructors/factory using the existing FOOD-001 composition-test approach to prove one repository, one service and one workspace; exact database/readDependencies forwarded; exact repository in service input; exact service in workspace input; exact resolver/admin preserved.
Repeated construction yields independent graphs with no cache while shared injected dependencies remain unchanged and unfrozen. Bundle freezes no class/dependency transitively.

Malformed outer inputs and throwing outer property getters produce the exact fixed input TypeError. Malformed database/read dependencies, resolver/admin and their throwing method getters preserve the applicable existing constructor TypeError; no raw exceptions leak and zero I/O occurs.
Canonical administrator rejected without normalization/defaulting; missing dependency never selects memory persistence or another database/resolver.
Denied operations through service and workspace perform fresh resolution and zero D1/FOOD-001 reads; revocation between calls is respected.

Authorized representative exact reads/list/mutations reach injected D1 and exact-read dependencies with unchanged IDs, versions, predecessor, cursors and receiver semantics; outcomes/conflict/sanitized failures retain E/F behavior.

Workspace exact-offer detail retains exact availability stream and second fresh authorization, not-found short circuit and fail-closed second-call behavior. No latest substitution or activation semantics.

Source isolation excludes environment/binding acquisition, server/session construction, HTTP/request parsing, gates, routes/UI, migration execution and unrelated subsystems. Existing D/E/F/G and FOOD-001 composition consumers remain unchanged.
futureImplementationValidation: Focused FOOD-002H composition tests using injected fakes and constructor instrumentation; no new database harness required for composition.
FOOD-002D/E/F/G regressions; any G integration regression executes only in its existing isolated Miniflare harness.
Relevant FOOD-001 composition and identity contract regressions if affected; no shared source changes.
Strict TypeScript for the two new files, git diff --check and normal build; do not fix unrelated baseline issues.
strictExclusions: Trusted environment acquisition, Astro/server-context acquisition, D1 binding lookup, globals or request context
Wrangler/worker/generated environment configuration changes, provisioning, migration execution or configured local/remote D1 access
Authorization redesign, menu operation gate, HTTP mutation parsing, Origin/CSRF work
Routes/actions/pages/UI/navigation, public projection route or menu activation
Concrete administrator configuration, deployment, production data or unrelated insurance/Sesh/creator changes
acceptanceCriteria: Exact injected four-field input and two-field authorized output defined; repository remains private.
One fresh repository/service/workspace graph, exact instance wiring, shallow-frozen bundle and zero construction I/O proven.
Existing constructor failure semantics and all D/E/F/G authorization/persistence/presentation semantics preserved without a new operation error vocabulary.
Only the two proposed implementation/test paths may be added after separate authorization; all required validation passes or unrelated baseline failures are reported.
currentTaskBoundary: Create only this specification after read-only discovery. Validate JSON, references, whitespace and diff; do not implement, stage, commit, push, access databases, migrate or activate anything.
